snippet.title: Two Point Campus: Medical School - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Two Point Campus: Medical School DLC is available now on PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X/S, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, and PC. Watch the trailer to learn about the Medical School DLC, where you join wandering paramedic Vitality Johnson to cure the sick, tackle pesky pirates, and embrace yeti wisdom.

#TwoPointCampus #MedicalSchool
